UNI_FACT.description: One row per university, UK league-table style 2027 edition (130 universities).

UNI_HISTORY_FACT.description: One row per university per edition: historic overall rank.

UNI_SUBJECT_FACT.description: Top-10 places per subject table, 2027 edition.

Total Score (2027).description: 2027 Total Score as a dimension, for range selections (what-if: universities between our score and our score plus a gain).

Avg Entry Points.description: Average Entry Standards (UCAS pts) across universities.

Avg Historic Rank.description: Average overall rank of the universities in the selection in each edition (history view; lower is better). Use by Edition.

Avg Places Gained.description: Average places climbed 2026 to 2027: Avg Rank 2026 minus Avg Rank 2027. Positive is good.

Avg Rank 2025.description: Average 2025 overall rank of the same universities (lower is better).

Avg Rank 2026.description: Average 2026 overall rank of the same universities (lower is better).

Avg Rank 2027.description: Average 2027 overall rank of the universities in the selection (lower is better).

Best Rank.description: Best (lowest) 2027 overall rank in the selection. Never sum ranks.

Climbers 2026.description: Universities that rose from 2025 to 2026 (Rank 2026 better than Rank 2025): last year's Climbers.

Climbers Change.description: Climbers this year minus climbers last year (2026 to 2027 vs 2025 to 2026). Positive is good.

Entry vs Set Average.description: Entry Standards (UCAS points) minus the average of every university in the current selection. Positive = ahead of the set.

Experience vs Set Average.description: Student Experience % minus the average of every university in the current selection (points). Positive = ahead of the set.

Fallers 2026.description: Universities that fell from 2025 to 2026 (Rank 2026 worse than Rank 2025): last year's Fallers.

Fallers Change.description: Fallers this year minus fallers last year. Negative is good.

Historic Rank.description: Overall rank in an edition (MIN; never sum).

Places Gained Since 2025.description: Rank in 2025 minus rank in 2027 (history view). Positive = climbed. Per university only.

Projected Rank at Score.description: The overall rank a university would hold with the 2027 Total Score given by parameter 'score' (default 572): universities scoring strictly above it, plus one. Ties are not broken.

Prospects vs Set Average.description: Graduate Prospects % minus the average of every university in the current selection (points). Positive = ahead of the set.

Rank (value).description: 2027 overall rank for a single university (MIN).

Rank 2026 (value).description: 2026 overall rank for a single university (MIN; never sum).

Rank Change (value).description: Places moved vs 2026 (positive = climbed). Use per university only.

Rank in 2025 Edition.description: Overall rank in the 2025 edition (history view, MIN; one university at a time).

Rank in 2027 Edition.description: Overall rank in the 2027 edition (history view, MIN; one university at a time).

Research vs Set Average.description: Research Quality % minus the average of every university in the current selection (points). Positive = ahead of the set.

Score Gap to Benchmark.description: Average 2027 Total Score minus the benchmark score (parameter 'benchmark', default 572 = Kent's 2027 total). Positive = scores above the benchmark university. The app sets the benchmark to the chosen university's score.

Subject Titles.description: Subject tables where the university ranks 1st.

Subject Wins.description: Subject tables topped by the university.

Top-10 Appearances.description: Editions in which the university was top 10.

Total Score Max.description: Highest 2027 total score in the selection.

Universities Scoring Above.description: Universities whose 2027 Total Score is above the parameter 'score' (default 572). With the chosen university's score plus a gain, this is how many would still rank above it.

Biggest climbers.question: Biggest climbers
Biggest climbers.description: Top 10 universities by places gained vs 2026.

Biggest fallers.question: Biggest fallers
Biggest fallers.description: Top 10 universities by places lost vs 2026.

Does each university's research quality.description: One point per university: Research Quality % against 2027 total score.

How did our rivals move this year?.description: Universities in the selection by movement since 2026.

How do university groups compare?.question: How do university groups compare?
How do university groups compare?.description: Average quality metrics by university group.

How far is each rank band behind the ban.description: Band average minus the average of the band above it, per measure (inter-record diff). Negative = behind.

How far is each rival from the rivals' a.description: Graduate Prospects % minus the average of the universities in the selection (points), from the stored measure Prospects vs Set Average. Positive = ahead.
Student Experience % minus the average of the universities in the selection (points), from the stored measure Experience vs Set Average. Positive = ahead.

How has our rank moved by edition?.description: Overall rank in each edition (2025-2027). The app narrows it to the chosen university. Lower is better.

How has the rival set's average rank mov.description: Average overall rank of the universities in the selection in each edition, with a two-edition moving average. Lower is better.

How many points of total score separate.description: Each university's 2027 Total Score minus ours (benchmark parameter, set by the app to the chosen university's score). Positive = scores above us.

How many universities climbed, vs last y.description: Universities that rose 2026 to 2027, against those that rose 2025 to 2026.

How many universities fell, vs last year.description: Universities that fell 2026 to 2027, against those that fell 2025 to 2026.

How many universities would still score.description: Universities whose 2027 Total Score is above our score plus the what-if gain (parameter score). Our projected rank is this plus one.
Universities in the selection; the what-if narrows it to totals above our score plus the gain.

How many universities would we overtake?.description: Universities in the selection. The app narrows it to Total Score above ours and at most ours plus the gain.

Subject titles by university.question: Subject titles by university
Subject titles by university.description: Top 10 universities by number of subject tables topped (2027).

Teaching vs research by university.question: Teaching vs research by university
Teaching vs research by university.description: Teaching quality against research quality for every university.

Top 10 rank history.question: Top 10 rank history
Top 10 rank history.description: Overall rank by edition for universities while in the top 10 (Historic Rank <= 10).

Top 10 universities 2027.question: Top 10 universities 2027
Top 10 universities 2027.description: Overall top 10 of the 2027 table by rank, with total score.

Universities by nation.question: Universities by nation
Universities by nation.description: Count of ranked universities per UK nation.

What is the average rank in view, 2027 v.description: Average overall rank of the universities in the current selection this year and last; places gained is positive when the group climbed.

What rank would a higher total score buy.description: Projected overall rank at our 2027 Total Score plus the what-if gain (parameter score), against every university in the 2027 table.

Where do we rank this year, and how far.description: 2027 overall rank, places moved since 2026 (positive = climbed) and the 2026 rank. The app narrows it to the chosen university.

Where does each rival rank on each measu.description: Rank of each university within the selection on each component (1 = best).

Which universities would we overtake?.description: League rows with rank, total score and the points they sit above us. The app narrows it to Total Score between our score and our score plus the gain.

Who is ahead of the rival set on entry s.description: Entry Standards (UCAS points) minus the average of the universities in the selection, from the stored measure Entry vs Set Average. Positive = ahead.

Who is ahead of the rival set on researc.description: Research Quality % minus the average of the universities in the selection (points), from the stored measure Research vs Set Average. Positive = ahead.

Who sits within 10 places of us, and how.description: League table rows; the app narrows it to the ranks around the chosen university.
